**Junior Astronaut – Mission Trainer**

Junior Astronaut – Mission Trainer is an educational 2D space exploration game designed to introduce beginners to the world of astronauts and space exploration. The project allows players to control an astronaut and explore a space environment through an interactive gaming experience.

The main goal is to make learning about space more engaging and accessible, especially for young learners who are curious about becoming astronauts but may not know where to start. By combining interactive gameplay with an educational theme, the project encourages curiosity, exploration, and interest in space science.

This project is important because inspiring the next generation of space explorers begins with making space education accessible, enjoyable, and engaging. It offers a simple first step into the exciting world of astronautics.
details:
Project Details – Junior Astronaut: Mission Trainer

Junior Astronaut: Mission Trainer is an interactive 2D educational game designed to introduce beginners to astronaut activities and the challenges of space exploration. The player takes control of an astronaut and experiences a simplified lunar exploration environment through different missions and tasks.

The game aims to make learning about space more engaging and accessible, especially for young people who are interested in astronomy and becoming astronauts. Through interactive gameplay, players can discover some of the responsibilities astronauts face during space missions, such as exploring the lunar surface, collecting scientific samples, and dealing with technical challenges.

The project's intended impact is to inspire curiosity about space science, encourage young learners to explore STEM subjects, and make astronaut training concepts easier to understand through an enjoyable experience.

The game was developed using Godot Engine, with programming and game-design techniques to create its interactive environment and gameplay. It was designed as a 2D experience to keep it accessible and beginner-friendly.

What makes this project creative is its combination of education and gaming. Instead of simply presenting information about astronauts, it allows players to experience a simplified version of space exploration themselves. The project focuses on accessibility, simplicity, educational value, and encouraging interest in future space exploration.

During development, I considered the target audience, ease of use, gameplay clarity, educational objectives, and the limitations of developing a game independently. I wanted to create something that could introduce the exciting world of space exploration to beginners without requiring advanced gaming experience.
